item.title: Your contributors are AI-first now. Is your project?
item.description: AI contributors are already in your queue. AutoGPT maintainer Nicholas Tindle shares the repo instructions, gates, and boundaries that keep maintainers in control. The post Your contributors are AI-first now. Is your project? (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Write your first prompt with the GitHub Copilot app
item.description: Learn how to write your first prompt in the GitHub Copilot app, choose the right context and model, and start your first task with confidence. The post Write your first prompt with the GitHub Copilot app appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Spotify Builds External Index to Enable Low Latency Point Queries on Its Data Lake
item.description: Spotify introduced external indexing architecture for Apache Parquet data lakes that enables low-latency point queries without replicating datasets into operational databases. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: GitHub availability report: July 2026
item.description: In July, we experienced eight incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services. The post GitHub availability report: July 2026 appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Presentation: Migrating Uber Eats Feeds to Webview
item.description: Nick DiStefano shares how Uber Eats migrated from traditional native app screens to a native-driven, single-page WebView architecture. (1 source: infoq)
